title: Talking About the Past - A múlt és a történetek
grammar: review the past tense (regular and irregular) and storytelling connectors

sections.title: Lesson Goals
items: I can talk about what I did, ate, drank, bought, saw and where I was, using the past tense with the definite/indefinite distinction.
I can tell a short story about the past using connectors like aztán, amikor, and egyszer csak.
